question.text: Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) was developed concurrently by:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** CAPM has four independent developers in the early-mid 1960s. Markowitz founded MPT; Fama did EMH; Black-Scholes did option pricing. **The Trap:** Only picking Sharpe misses Treynor, Lintner, Mossin. **Cross-Exam Context:** Finance history canon. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Sharpe received the 1990 Nobel along with Markowitz (for MPT) and Miller (for corporate finance).
